tweets.text:
Vibe Strategy will now serve as Good Vibes Club’s ecosystem token.

Strategy tokens represent a new ecosystem taking shape. The true magic happens with what we can build around decentralized guardrails.

In the spirit of fair distribution, we plan to market-purchase 69Ξ (~300k USD) of $VIBESTR for the GVC treasury, a direct commitment to building alongside our community. Half now, and the other half will come in the following days and weeks.

This represents more than alignment, it’s the start of an incentive layer built around collector experiences, brand partnerships, and community activations.

We believe this marks the beginning of a new era for how brands build around the best interests of their community.

With Good Vibes Club, we aim to take a lead role in shaping this future.

tweets.text:
Vibe Coding Developer Learning Roadmap.

|-- Core Programming & Logic
| |-- Syntax, Variables & Data Types
| |-- Control Flow: if-else, switch
| |-- Loops: for, while, do-while
| |-- Functions, Arrow Functions & Higher-Order Functions
| |-- Scope, Closures & Execution Context
| |-- Error Handling & Debugging

|-- Web Fundamentals
| |-- HTML & Semantic Markup
| |-- CSS Basics: selectors, properties, the box model
| |-- Layout: Flexbox, Grid
| |-- Responsive Design & Media Queries
| |-- CSS Preprocessors (SASS, LESS)
| |-- CSS Architecture (BEM, SMACSS)

|-- Advanced JavaScript & Ecosystem
| |-- ES6+ Features: destructuring, spread/rest, modules
| |-- Async JS: Promises, async/await
| |-- Generators, Iterators, Symbols
| |-- Transpilation (Babel) & Polyfills
| |-- Bundlers: Webpack, Rollup, Parcel
| |-- Module Systems: ES Modules, CommonJS

|-- Frontend Frameworks & UI
| |-- React / Vue / Angular (pick your vibe)
| |-- Component Architecture & Composition
| |-- State Management (Redux, Vuex, Context API)
| |-- Routing & Navigation
| |-- Hooks, Lifecycle & Performance Patterns
| |-- Styling: CSS Modules, Styled-Components, Tailwind

|-- APIs & Backend Integration
| |-- RESTful API Design & Consumption
| |-- GraphQL (queries, mutations, subscriptions)
| |-- WebSockets & Real-time Communication
| |-- Fetch, Axios & HTTP Clients
| |-- Authentication & Authorization (JWT, OAuth)
| |-- Data Flow, Caching & Offline Strategies

|-- State & Data Management Patterns
| |-- Local & Global State Patterns
| |-- Flux, Redux, MobX, Zustand
| |-- Data Normalization & Memoization
| |-- Context, Providers & Hooks
| |-- Optimistic Updates & Reconciliation

|-- Testing & Code Quality
| |-- Unit Testing (Jest, Mocha)
| |-- Component & Integration Testing
| |-- End-to-End Testing (Cypress, Playwright)
| |-- Linting & Formatting (ESLint, Prettier)
| |-- Type Checking (TypeScript or Flow)

|-- Performance & Optimization
| |-- Code Splitting & Lazy Loading
| |-- Memoization, Throttling, Debouncing
| |-- Tree Shaking & Minification
| |-- Image & Asset Optimization
| |-- Web Vitals, Rendering Path & Metrics

|-- Build, Deployment & DevOps Basics
| |-- Package Managers (npm, yarn, pnpm)
| |-- Build Scripts & Tooling
| |-- CI / CD Setup
| |-- Docker & Container Basics
| |-- Hosting & Deployment (Netlify, Vercel, AWS, etc.)
| |-- Monitoring & Logging

|-- Project & Portfolio Creation
| |-- UI Components & Mini-Apps
| |-- Fullstack Projects (with backend integration)
| |-- Real-world Applications (chat, e-commerce, dashboards)
| |-- Real-time & Collaborative Tools
| |-- Open Source Contributions & Team Projects

|-- Growth, Trends & Community
| |-- Reading Official Docs & Specs
| |-- Blogs, Tutorials & Workshops
| |-- Community Participation & Forums
| |-- Experimenting with New Libraries & Patterns
| |-- Keeping Up with JS / Web Trends
